entities.title: "All the games" on the scores page goes to the About page
entities.summary: The scores page's "← All the games" link points at /, which on icelander.net is the About page, not the list of games.
entities.expected: "← All the games" opens the games list at /games/, as the page's own header and footer links named Games do.
entities.observed: It links to / (icelander.net/), a leftover from when the games lived at the root of games.icelander.net. The game moved to icelander.net/games/retro/shatterbelt in commit edfb3fe, which updated the Play link beside it but not this one.

origin.description: Found while documenting Shatterbelt: scoresPage's side panel beside look.ts's navigation, which links Games to /games/ and About to icelander.net/.
